focus_area: Frontend regenerate confirm modal, read-only view slide-over, and the useAiJobCriteria query+mutation hook (mutation ownership, loading/disabled double-submit protection, frozen-prop trap, query-key/invalidation shape)

findings.title: JobCriteriaViewModal criterion rows keyed by array index
findings.description: Criterion rows use `key={index}` (`<Styled.Row key={index}>`). The `criteria` prop is frozen at openModal time (ModalContext captures the element) and the list is display-only, never reordered or filtered after render, so index keys are stable and there is no reconciliation bug. Purely a stylistic observation with no actionable consequence.
findings.recommendation: Optional: key on a stable field (e.g. `criterion.text`) if duplicate-text criteria are ever possible. No functional change required.
